_aviso: GUION ESCRITO A MANO para probar el flujo sin red. NO es salida de un LLM: no usar como resultado de un modelo.

mutants.description: only compacts tiles to the left, never merges
after a merge prev is not reset, so a tile can merge again
merges equal neighbors in place without compacting zeros
a merge keeps the tile value instead of doubling it
skips non-positive values (equivalent under the precondition)

fn_assertion.explanation: Merging never creates or destroys value, so the sum of the tiles is preserved; and after sliding left there is no zero before a non-zero tile.
